# Nectar.Pay

> Non-custodial crypto payment gateway for merchants. Accept BTC, TEXITcoin, and EVM stablecoins (USDC, USDT, PYUSD, DAI) direct to your own wallet — no custody, no per-transaction fees.

Nectar.Pay is part of the Honest Money ecosystem. Merchants paste a public key (xpub/zpub or EVM address); customers pay; funds land in the merchant's wallet without an intermediary.

## Public API (for third-party integrations)

Base URL: `https://app.nectar-pay.com` — all calls authenticate with
`Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...` (per-store key, shown once at creation).

- `GET  /api/public/v1/me` — verify a key; returns store + configured webhook URL.
- `POST /api/public/v1/invoices` — create an invoice. Body: `amount` (fiat, required),
  `currency` (default USD), `chain` (optional: btc, lightning, txc, eth, base, tron, sol,
  doge, ltc, bch, dash, isk, zcu — omit to let the customer pick on the hosted checkout),
  `order_id`, `description`, `redirect_url`, `buyer_email`, `expires_in_seconds` (60–86400).
  Returns `id`, `address`, `crypto_amount`, `rate`, `status`, `expires_at`, `checkout_url`.
- `GET  /api/public/v1/invoices/{id}` — invoice status (pending | underpaid | confirmed | expired).
- `GET  /api/public/v1/invoices` — list invoices. Filters: `status`, `chain` (comma-separated),
  `order_id`, `since`, `until`, `limit` (1–200), `offset`. Returns `total` + `invoices[]`.
- `POST /api/public/v1/invoices/{id}/email` — email the payment request to the customer.
  Body `{ "to": "..." }` optional; defaults to the invoice's `buyer_email`.
- `GET  /api/public/v1/invoices/{id}/webhooks` — delivery history (attempt, status_code,
  delivered_at, next_retry_at, event_type, response body excerpt).
- `POST /api/public/v1/invoices/{id}?action=redeliver-webhook` — resend the webhook for one invoice.
- `GET  /api/public/v1/rates` — live USD rates per chain; `?amount=25` adds converted
  crypto amounts. Stablecoins (USDC, USDT, TSD) pegged at $1.
- `GET  /api/public/v1/store` — store profile: currency, tax settings, invoice TTL, enabled
  chains/tokens, whether a webhook is configured, hosted payment links.
- `GET|POST /api/public/v1/links` and `GET|PATCH|DELETE /api/public/v1/links/{slug}` —
  manage reusable hosted payment links at `https://app.nectar-pay.com/t/{slug}`.
  Fields: `slug`, `title`, `subtitle`, `cta_label`, `currency`, `preset_amounts`,
  `allow_custom_amount`, `min_amount`, `max_amount`, `is_donation`, `active`.
- Webhooks: signed POST to the store's webhook URL. Header
  `X-TXCPay-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex>` where `v1 = HMAC_SHA256(webhook_secret, "{t}.{rawBody}")`.
  Event types: `invoice.paid`, `invoice.confirmed`, `invoice.underpaid`.
- Drop-in checkout button: `<script src="https://app.nectar-pay.com/sdk/payhme.js">` + a
  `data-payhme` button, or `PayHME.checkout({ apiKey, chain, amount, currency, orderId })`.
- Hosted payment page (no code): `https://app.nectar-pay.com/t/{store-slug}`.

Full reference with copy-paste examples: [/docs](/docs).
